test_Counter_reset: test the Counter wrapper to verify reset call counts increment correctly on an LlvmEnv
test_Counter_step: test the Counter wrapper to verify step call counts increment after calling env.step
test_Counter_double_close: test the Counter wrapper to verify close call counts increment on multiple close calls
run_Counter_wrapper: run the Counter wrapper on an LlvmEnv to track reset, step, close, and fork call counts
review_Counter_test: review the Counter wrapper unit tests that validate method call counting on an LlvmEnv
